attributes.action: Allow escooters use for general public use without persecution or loss
attributes.additional_details:
We would be allowing ordinary folks the ability to save money, the planet and getting to and from places of work or leisure. 

Police have been instructed to remove the items and prosecute the operator for travel on pathways and redways and we believe this is not on. 

To and from a place of work to reduce the costs of living or to places of leisure. 

This mode of transport is saving the planet and saving money for the owners.
attributes.background: Allow the general public the ability to use escooters for use with the same regulations as ebikes.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this matter which you may wish to sign:

Legalise public use of private e-scooters for over 18s with helmets
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776047

We also have another, related, petition, which might also interest you:

Legalise and regulate e-scooters & e-bikes exceeding current limits for road use
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/765825
